Xelix/Oversight for Vendor Query Management and statements reconciliation

Currently handled using Sequence for vendor query management and 3 RPA bots for supplier statement reconciliations.
This creates inefficiencies, delays issue resolution, and increases workload. Xelix or Oversight provide an opportunity to automate, centralize, and streamline these processes, improving supplier experience, productivity, and payment accuracy.

Legacy duplicate-payment controls (Galvanize/HighBond) generate high volumes of false positives, require significant manual effort, and have known operational limitations.
Replace the legacy rule-based approach with Xelix's AI-driven duplicate payment detection capability to improve detection accuracy, reduce manual effort, strengthen AP controls, and lower duplicate-payment risk.
AI agent for OCR invoice processing errors for legacy FERPs
Agent 1 will perform extraction of invoice data from APS where OCR failed to process. Agents 2 and 3 will process invoice exception resolution and posting in legacy ERPs (SAP and Oracle).

• Agent 1 is live
• Agents 2 and 3 are under development
